I replied to Ilse in their DM and nowhere else. I told them the possible move of the Tansley Parcel depot to Bay 35 stays between us. I also said I won't repeat it in any channel or to any other member, and I'll help announce it if it's confirmed.

I didn't save the rumor to gbrain or any other shared store, since that could carry it into other people's conversations. I didn't search or read any channels either, because the message didn't ask for anything beyond a reply.
